selected_lines.text: - When adding or changing state, an index, lock, transaction, queue, cache, external side effect, or compensation, cover every applicable lifecycle boundary in `checks` or `evidence`: normal completion, concurrency, timeout/provider failure, interruption/crash, restart/recovery, rollback/conflict, and a cannot-bypass test. State why a boundary is not applicable instead of inventing requirements.
- AC-1：空串、纯 LF、CRLF、单 CR、混合换行、Unicode、末尾有/无换行、连续空行至少八种输入有明确期望，重复规范化保持相同结果。
- AC-2：实际执行测试，实际输出明确显示覆盖数、零 failure/error，并与测试源码中的案例相符。本任务不要求工具提供独立测量的真实退出码，但测试完成状态或文字结论本身不能替代实际输入/输出与测试结果。
- If the Context Package contains a Read Reuse Contract, follow that contract exactly. Do not invent read-reuse fields when the contract does not declare them.
